No. S 40

BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY SENDIRIAN BERHAD

ORDER, 2002 (S 6/2002)

NOTICE ON THE GRANTING OF MINERAL RIGHTS BY

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN IN COUNCIL (section 3(1)) It is hereby notified that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has, on the 30th. day of June, 2011 pursuant to section 3(1) of the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad Order, 2002, granted all mineral rights to the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad within the designated area referred to as Block B having the following coordinates - B2 (Block B East)
